sn17.3:1.3: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave aññatarasmiṃ udakarahade mahākummakulaṃ ciranivāsi ahosi || || 4
sn17.3:1.4: Atha kho bhikkhave aññataro kummo aññataraṃ kummam etad avoca || ||
sn17.3:1.5: Mā kho tvaṃ tāta kumma etaṃ padesam agamāsīti || || 5
sn17.3:1.6: Agamāsi kho bhikkhave so kummo tam padesam ||
sn17.3:1.8: Atha kho bhikkhave so kummo yena so kummo tenupasaṅkami || || 7
sn17.3:1.9: Addasā kho bhikkhave so kummo taṃ kummaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ || ||
sn17.3:1.11: Kacci tvaṃ tāta kumma na tam padesam āgamāsīti || ||
sn17.3:1.12: Agamāsiṃ khvāhaṃ tāta kumma tam padesanti || || 8
sn17.3:1.13: Kacci panāsi tāta kumma akkhato anupahato ti || ||
sn17.3:1.14: Akkhato kho mhi tāta kumma anupahato || atthi ca me idaṃ suttakaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhanti || || 9
sn17.3:1.15: Tagghasi tāta kumma khato taggha upahato ||
sn17.3:1.16: Etena hi te tāta kumma luddakena pitaro ca pitāmahā ca anayam āpannā vyasanam āpannā || ||
sn17.3:1.17: Gaccha dāni tvaṃ tāta kumma na dāni tvam amhākanti || || 10
sn17.3:2.1: Luddo ti kho bhikkhave Mārassetam pāpimato ādhivacanaṃ ||
sn17.3:2.4: Yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokam assādeti nikāmeti ||
sn17.3:2.5: ayam vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu giddho papatāya anayam āpanno vyasanam āpanno yathākāmakaranīyo pāpimato || || 12
sn17.3:2.6: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || 13
